cause_quote: The Sign in with ChatGPT feature commit added `export const TOKEN_SHARING_REDIRECT_URI = "http://localhost:8080/auth/callback";`, a fixed callback port whose bind fails with EADDRINUSE whenever another app holds 8080.
user_saw: Sign in with ChatGPT (Beta) failed with an address-in-use error whenever another app was listening on port 8080.
summary: SIWC now binds the loopback callback on an OS-chosen free port and uses that bound redirect in both the authorization URL and token exchange; the shared callback server accepts port 0.
reasoning: The fixed 8080 redirect was present from the commit that introduced Sign in with ChatGPT (67fd7e910b89, the first commit touching token-sharing.ts) and never changed until this fix, so the failure on an occupied port shipped with the feature. Medium rather than high because the fixed port may have been a deliberate registration choice at the time, but the PR treats it as a defect with a reported issue (#191507).
